PRESIDENT'S ORDER 1 OF 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 1
OF 1985
HIGH
COURT JUDGES (LEAVE, PENSION AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th January, 1985]
No. F. 17(3)/85-Pub.-The
following Order, made by the President, is hereby published for general
information :--
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1970 (P.
O. No. 9 of 1970), for the purpose hereinafter appearing ;
Now, therefore, in, pursuance of
the Proclamation of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers
enabling him in that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following
order :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Order may be called the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and
Privileges) (Amendment) Order, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the first day of June, 1981.
2. Amendment of paragraph 20, P. O. No. 9 of 1970.--In the High
Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1970 (P. O. No. 9 of 1970),
in paragraph 20,-
(a) after the words "Supreme
Court", occurring for the first time the words "or as Chief Justice
of the Federal Shariat Court" shall be inserted ; and
(b) after the words "Supreme Court", at the end, the
commas and words "or, as the case may be, Chief Justice of the Federal
Shariat Court" shall be added.. ,
